verdict.rationale: Featurebase exposes a genuine API surface covering many core UI functions—feedback posts, reports analytics, help-center article editing, training data, and webhooks—suggesting real functional parity for support/feedback workflows. However there's no explicit claim or evidence of full 1:1 API/UI parity, and the openapi.json/swagger.json probe returned 404s, meaning no machine-readable full spec is discoverable to verify completeness across all UI features (e.g., workflows, integrations, changelog publishing, roadmap voting). missing for 10: explicit full API/UI parity documentation, a working OpenAPI/swagger spec, and evidence that non-support UI areas (workflows, integrations, changelog/roadmap management) are API-accessible.
